description: Construction of Teachers’ Quarters in selected plantation schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - There are 864 schools established in the areas of tea and rubber estates in the Central, Uva, Sabaragamuwa, Western, Southern and North Western Provinces. Since most of these schools in the plantation areas are located far from the main cities, it has become difficult for principals and teachers to access these schools. Due to the shortage of teachers in the secondary classes of these schools, the overall performance of these schools in national examinations such as the G.C.E. Ordinary Level and Advanced Level has been revealed to be low compared to other government schools. That situation has resulted in causing the youth to be confined to unskilled labour. Therefore, it has become an essential factor to increase the human and physical resources in the schools of plantation areas. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to implement a project to construct teachers’ quarters in 14 selected schools in plantation areas of those provinces which are in need of teachers’ quarters, enabling to minimize the teacher shortage and increase the human resources of those schools, through the relevant Provincial Councils, was approved by the Cabinet.
